name: Angkor Wat International Half Marathon
short_description: A half marathon and multi-distance road race held at the Angkor Wat temple complex in Siem Reap, Cambodia, scheduled for December 6, 2026.
ai_summary: The Angkor Wat International Half Marathon is set to take place on Sunday 6 December 2026, starting and finishing in front of Angkor Wat within Angkor Archaeological Park in Siem Reap, Cambodia. It is organised by the Angkor Wat International Half Marathon Organization Executive Committee Cambodia and Japan, co-organised by the National Olympic Committee of Cambodia and sanctioned by AIMS and the Khmer Amateur Athletics Federation. The event offers four distances: 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km and 3 km.

core_facts.organizer: Angkor Wat International Half Marathon Organization Executive Committee Cambodia and Japan; co-organised by the National Olympic Committee of Cambodia; sanctioned by AIMS and the Khmer Amateur Athletics Federation
core_facts.venue: Angkor Wat temple complex, Angkor Archaeological Park

pros: Flat course through the Angkor park, through Angkor Thom's Victory Gate and South Gate
Mild pre-dawn air: 21°C with a 19°C dew point at 4.30am in 2025
Water and electrolyte drinks every 2 km
Four-hour half-marathon limit, plus 5 km and 3 km races that can be walked
Charity race for landmine victims, held every December since 1996
cons: Crowded start and a slow medal queue at the finish in 2025
Water handed out in full bottles, not cups
Race packs must be collected in person beforehand; no race-day collection
Transport to and from the start has to be arranged in advance

faqs.question: When is the Angkor Wat International Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Angkor Wat International Half Marathon is scheduled to take place on December 6, 2026. The race is held at the Angkor Wat temple complex, located within Angkor Archaeological Park in Siem Reap, Cambodia, giving participants a unique setting for the event.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distances: a 21.1 km half marathon, which is the headline race, plus 10 km, 5 km and 3 km. The 2026 start times are 5.50am for the half marathon, 6.10am for the 5 km, 6.25am for the 3 km and 6.40am for the 10 km. The organiser says the 2026 course map may still change.

faqs.question: Who organises the Angkor Wat International Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The race is organised by the Angkor Wat International Half Marathon Organization Executive Committee Cambodia and Japan, with the National Olympic Committee of Cambodia as co-organiser. It is sanctioned by AIMS and the Khmer Amateur Athletics Federation. Held every December since 1996, it raises money to support landmine victims.
